content: दर्श, दर्शक, दर्शन <ab>&c.</ab>¦ See under दृश्.

दर्शक {%a.%} (-का|-र्शिका|{%f.%}) [दृश्-णिच् ण्वुल्] .²1 Seeing, observing <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Showing, pointing out; विधिप्रयुक्तसत्कारैः स्वयं मार्गस्य दर्शकः <ls>Ku. 6. 52</ls>. .²3 Examining, looking out for. .²4 Explaining, making clear, elucidating .{@-कः@} .²1 One who shows or exhibits. .²2 A door-keeper, warder. .²3 A skilful man, one proficient in any art or science.
